one_liner: GoHighLevel has a broad REST v2 API with OAuth 2.0 and Private Integration Tokens, an official hosted MCP server, but API access requires a paid plan (trial only ~14 days).
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow for Marketplace apps (agency and location tokens), plus Private Integration Tokens (static bearer). Some third-party sources claim OAuth needs Agency Pro, but the official help center says OAuth is available on all plans.
access_notes: No free tier. API access is bundled with paid plans (Starter $97 and up). A standard 14-day trial of the paid product is available, and the API works during it. Some endpoints (Create Sub-Account, Enable SaaS) need Agency Pro.
blocker_notes: The builder needs a paid HighLevel subscription (about $97/month and up) after a short ~14-day trial. Some endpoints need Agency Pro at $497/month.

evidence.quote: Both **OAuth 2.0** and **Private Integration Tokens (PIT)** are available across all plans, allowing developers to build integrations and access supported APIs without requiring an Agency Pro subscription.
| Starter | $97 | Standard API access, subject to endpoint restrictions |
Webhooks | More than 70 events, retried up to 12 times
This SDK provides a comprehensive interface to interact with all HighLevel API endpoints with built-in authentication, error handling, and automatic token refresh.
The active catalog includes **more than 600 read, create, update, and delete operations across 38 domains**.
